bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/userbot-room-ipc-d0bdcaf"
test -x "$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" || exit 42
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = d0bdcaf52040b3a090d055ccaee98783d15e4bbf || exit 43
ROOT_DIR="$r" SOURCE_DIR="$w" "$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, sys
root=pathlib.Path(os.environ["ROOT_DIR"])
source=pathlib.Path(os.environ["SOURCE_DIR"])
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"scripts"))
import userbot_session
assert userbot_session.SECRETS == root/"deploy"/"secrets"
assert callable(userbot_session.load_credentials)
sys.path.remove(str(root/"scripts"))
sys.path.insert(0,str(source/"scripts"))
import telethon, userbot_resident_ipc, userbot_room_smoke, userbot_keepalive, userbot_test_client
assert "room_private_smoke" in userbot_resident_ipc.ACTIONS
assert userbot_resident_ipc.SOCKET_PATH == root/"deploy"/"secrets"/"userbot_verify.sock"
assert callable(userbot_room_smoke.run)
assert userbot_test_client.SOCKET_PATH == userbot_resident_ipc.SOCKET_PATH
print("ROOT_SESSION_API_COMPATIBLE=YES")
print("RESIDENT_IPC_STAGING_IMPORT_PASS")
print("TELETHON_INSTALLED=YES")
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 46
echo USERBOT_SERVICE_UNCHANGED=YES
